release verify.reason: Exercises real-gh unsigned-release rejection, missing tag/repository HTTP 404, latest selection, invalid input and all output flags. Successful cryptographic verification cannot be arranged with the harness fixtures: Codeyard's urn:codeyard:release:v1 node signature is deliberately not a GitHub/Sigstore attestation. No external trust-service traffic or fabricated trusted bundle is used.

release verify-asset.reason: Exercises real-gh unsigned-asset rejection against an uploaded live asset, missing file/tag/repository, latest selection and all output flags. Trusted-verification success is not asserted: the harness cannot issue a GitHub/Sigstore release attestation, and Codeyard's self-hosted node signature makes no such identity claim.
